parsed.name: GPIO 距离传感器
parsed.description: 通过 GPIO 触发/回读实现距离测量的通用传感器接口，常见于超声波测距模块。
parsed.description_en: A generic GPIO-based distance sensing interface, commonly used with ultrasonic ranging modules.

actions.description: 关闭设备并释放 GPIO 引脚。
actions.description_en: Close the device and release its GPIO pins.
